condition.narrative: Consistent with the Article III of the SBAA [or the Supplemental Provisions to the Project Document], the responsibility for the safety and security of the Implementing Partner and its personnel and property, and of UNDP’s property in the Implementing Partner’s custody, rests with the Implementing Partner. To this end, the Implementing Partner shall: a) put in place an appropriate security plan and maintain the security plan, taking into account the security situation in the country where the project is being carried; b) assume all risks and liabilities related to the Implementing Partner’s security, and the full implementation of the security plan.

Social and environmental sustainability will be enhanced through application of the UNDP Social and Environmental Standards (http://www.undp.org/ses) and related Accountability Mechanism (http://www.undp.org/secu-srm).

description.narrative: Energy Efficiency/ Renewable Energy Strategy/ Policy/ Action Plan in place with nationally adopted targets

comment.narrative: Currently the country does not have a coherent approach to address issues of sustainable energy; mainly energy efficiency and renewable energy. There is no National Energy Policy Paper; Energy Efficiency Strategy nor Renewable Energy Strategy. There are no national targets for energy efficiency or renewable energy.

National Renewable Energy Action Plan (NREAP) initiatives / policies developed 2020 milestone targets: o Review of National Renewable Energy Action Plan and its implementation o Develop Policy Guidance Papers to stimulate further uptake of Renewable Energy Technologies o Develop with relevant authorities a Commercial Registration (CR) for Renewable Energy Consultants and Contractors o Complete any legal requirements to formalize the establishment of a CR and Commercial Activities in regard to Renewable Energy o Support Government in implementing Renewable Energy on Government Rooftop Projects via public tender o Support Government in developing Renewable Energy on Infrastructure and Public Works Projects o Support Government in assessing technical and financial viability of wind resources and support in the development of documents relating to procurement of Grid Scale Utility Generation from Wind Resources which are deemed viable o Promote the uptake of renewable energy technology in industrial facilities o Promote market stimulation through awareness raising, technical support and development of local technical capacity o Improve technical and financial viability of Renewable Energy Projects by advocating and implementing appropriate policies and platform
National Energy Efficiency Action Plan (NEEAP) initiatives / policies developed 2020 milestones targets: 1. Minimum Energy Performance Standards & Labeling of Large Air Conditioning Units 2. Regulation of District Cooling marketplace 3. Green Building Initiative - specifically Green Building Rating Scheme design and implementation as well as phase1 of Green Building Code implementation and follow up 4. Industry Program (Industry A to continue making progress towards their commitment of 1% energy efficiency improvement year on year – Industry B Case Study to be developed) 5. Street Lighting (National street lighting conversion to LED to continue) 6. Government Buildings Energy Management (Framework to be to implemented in government buildings to continue implementation of EnMS strategy, further case studies to be developed to increase uptake by more parties) 7. Green Public Procurement (Manual to be advocated for with Ministry of Finance and National Economy and integrated into standard financial manual) 8. Promote the uptake of energy efficiency technologies in industrial facilities 9. Promote market stimulation through awareness raising, technical support and development of local technical capacity 10. Review of National Energy Efficiency Action Plan and its implementation 11. Develop Policy Guidance Papers to stimulate further uptake of Energy Efficiency Technologies

SEU 2020 NREAP Achievements:
• Hired a consultant to conduct the Review of National Renewable Energy Action Plan and its implementation • Developed several Policy Guidance Papers including Memorandum to Cabinet, Policy White Papers to stimulate further uptake of Renewable Energy Technologies via the advocation of supportive and enabling public policy in regard to Renewable Energy o Memo to Ministry of Housing Undersecretary advocating the integration of RE provisions in new social housing developments o Memo to Ministerial Infrastructure Committee and subsequently to Executive Committee advocating the use of Power Purchase Agreements for long term public renewable energy projects o Memo to Executive Committee advocating the creation of dedicated CR for Renewable Energy Consultants and Contractors. • Developed with Council for the Regulation of Professional Engineering Practices a proposed Commercial Registration process and design for Renewable Energy Consultants and with Ministry of Industry Commerce and Tourism for Renewable Energy Contractors (Both of which are currently under review for prior to final approval and Adoption). • A Ministerial Decree for the formalization of the two Renewable Energy CRs mention above has been undertaken and it is ready to be used once final approvals are attained. • SEU engaged international consultants to support in the development of technical RFP documents for a public tender to integrate Solar into government rooftops. • SEU supported the Government throughout the Public Tender process for the development of the first batch of Solar Plants for Government Rooftops (3MWp) out of a potential 50MWp. The first batch is due to be awarded to winning consortia via the process of the National Tender Board of Bahrain. • SEU has worked with Ministry of Transport and Telecommunications – Roads Planning and Design Directorate to develop two proposals: o Integration of renewable energy into two new national infrastructure projects (bridges) o Use of renewable energy as a backup power source for critical infrastructure (traffic lights) NB: An international consultant was engaged to support in one of the bridge designs • Support Government in assessing technical and financial viability of wind resources and support in the development of documents relating to procurement of Grid Scale Generation from Wind Resources which are deemed viable • Developed with the local Labor Market Fund (Tamkeen) a financing product and designed a pilot scheme for its launch including proposals to support the uptake of renewable energy technology in industrial facilities • Attended and supported several national events to promote market stimulation through awareness raising • Offered technical support to over 10 ministries and several private sector companies for the design, procurement, installation and commissioning of and Renewable Energy Technologies • Proposed, designed, led the procurement of services to develop and implement a National Renewable Energy Certificate Trading Platform to improve technical and financial viability of Renewable Energy Projects • Advocated for, designed and currently implementing appropriate policies for the regulation of the REC trading platform o Including the first REC Decree establishing the legal basis for RECs in the country • Pavilion project.
% of targeted installed RE capacity achieved to date (2020 Actual Milestone Achievements):
The recorded capacities and projects between those implemented and initiated or committed to are at around 175 MWp, which translate to 70% achievement of the target so far through the following:
• Large Scale Solar Farm –capacity of 100MW • Tatweer Petroleum Project –capacity of 4MW • Bapco – 5MW • Electricity & Water Authority Project –capacity of 5MW • National Waste Management Strategy – Waste to Energy capacity of 50MW • Developers and Constructors Projects –capacity of 11MW (being 30% in progress projects out of 36.5MW in pipeline)
SEU 2020 NEEAP Achievements:
1. Supported the Ministry of Industry Commerce and Tourism in the technical development and review of Minimum Energy Performance Standards & Labeling of Large Air Conditioning Units (>65,000BTU/Hr) 2. Draft regulations were developed in coordination with Central Planning Office of Ministry of Works Municipalities and Urban Planning for the regulation of the District Cooling marketplace a. To be reviewed by Ministerial Infrastructure Committee and if approved to be submitted to Legal and Legislative Opinion Committee for review and raising to cabinet 3. Supported the Government in the development of tender documents to continue the implementation of the Green Building Initiative - specifically Green Building Rating Scheme design and implementation as well as phase1 of Green Building Code implementation and follow up a. Followed up with ministry of Works, Municipality and Urban Planning on the implementation of the first phases of the Green Building Code 4. Developed with the local Labor Market Fund (Tamkeen) a financing product and designed a pilot scheme for its launch including proposals to support the Industry A to continue making progress towards their commitment of 1% energy efficiency improvement year on year. 5. Industry B can also take advantage of the financing package developed as well as learn from best practices established via a series of Case Studies developed and shared at local events 6. Followed up with Electricity and Water Authority on the implementation of the national program for street lighting conversion to LED 7. Advocated with the Ministry of Works Municipality and Urban Planning to integrate the developed framework for EnMS in government buildings into their maintenance strategy, further case studies to be developed to increase uptake by more parties) 8. Promoted the uptake of energy efficiency technologies in industrial facilities at over 10 local events by providing content, speakers and technical support 9. Engaged international consultant to conduct Review of National Energy Efficiency Action Plan and its implementation
